scope: Additive editorial explanations; original records and their fields remain unchanged. expected_values pins only the cited fields.
pointer_format: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer; each expected_values key addresses the original record.

general_rules.meaning: Success of the specific script checks at that stage; read interpretation and write/readback state.
Historical readiness of exact old inputs and guards, never current authorization or portable hardware validation.
Runner-specific name; in the annotated system runner it means userdata partition writes.
Resolve stage and observation time; stage-local final and earlier pending flags may precede the current summary.
Unavailable original inputs; do not replace them with guessed values or treat work paths as repository-relative.

notes.meaning: data_writes means writes to Android userdata (/data) in this runner. Four /system ranges were written; this is not a no-NAND-write flag.
notes.do_not_infer: Do not translate data_writes=false into no device data was written.

notes.meaning: The measurement completed successfully and found two damaged BBT copies; interpretation in the same record states this explicitly.
notes.do_not_infer: Do not infer healthy BBT, repair success or a bootable console from all_pass=true.

notes.meaning: The target compared exact, then the protected-view check stopped. A write was already dispatched.
notes.do_not_infer: Do not retry the write from the final false flag; inspect native execution and target/protected readback separately.

notes.meaning: This runner attempt stopped at a host-side assertion before the userdata repair was attempted.
notes.do_not_infer: Do not merge this attempt with the later write or infer userdata repair occurred.

notes.meaning: The repair checker reported corrected errors (exit 1); the subsequent read-only verification reported clean (exit 0).
notes.do_not_infer: Do not classify the correcting exit as a failed repair or generalize this outcome to mounted filesystems.

notes.meaning: Stage-local final verifies the diagnostic boot image through both FTL views. It predates later Linux work and stock-boot return.
notes.do_not_infer: Do not treat the filename final or exact readback as final functional validation.

notes.meaning: Readiness described the old case-specific build and inputs, prepared without device access in this manifest.
notes.do_not_infer: Do not treat this as current authorization, a portable binary or proof of physical NAND behavior.

notes.meaning: Offline reconstruction used three actual block readbacks and clean-image free space. Only allocated filesystem ranges have that readback coverage.
notes.do_not_infer: Do not infer the complete cache partition was reread from NAND or overwritten.

notes.meaning: The first pending flag records the earlier binary-readback time. current_status incorporates the later separate operator cold-start confirmation.
notes.do_not_infer: Do not erase the timing distinction, treat these flags as contradictory, or invent a new binary read after that power cycle.

notes.meaning: Stock-boot cold startup and game operation were operator-reported functional observations. Save import was observed in the preceding temporary-host test.
notes.do_not_infer: Do not promote a functional observation to fresh binary NAND verification or a fresh save-import test.

notes.meaning: The validation list consolidates observations across the original repair. validation_limits supplies their timing; it is not a list of tests all repeated after final stock return.
notes.do_not_infer: Do not attach all listed observations to the last power cycle.
